lina (product): Quick thread to lock scope: long-term work for routing policies + multi-region + tenant isolation. Customer asks: per-route region pin, auditable isolation, and a cheaper "economic" lane. Can we list must-haves for a pilot?

omar (eng-platform): Must-have: clear SLO bands per lane and a simple fallback policy. Also need a rough infra delta (GPU + egress) per lane.

trent (arch): Policy v0 should be tiny: selector, regions[], lane, fallback, lock. Deterministic precedence: exact > prefix > global. Engine emits reason for each decision.

yun (infra): Caveat: cross-region fallback = cold KV-cache penalty and egress. I'll run a tiny sim for three traffic types and return cold-start ms + egress estimate (2w).

claire (solutions): Compliance must-haves: per-tenant routing log export, signed attestations for private deployments, and a migration checklist. Make those explicit launch gates.

harry (sales): I can get 2 pilot customers if we can promise instrumentation: p95/p99, failover delta, and per-lane cost. Pilot helps renewals.

lina (product): Draft pilot gates: 1) two pilots onboarded; 2) lane SLOs defined + measured; 3) migration runbook + rollback; 4) policy manifest + UI for edits; 5) routing audit export + attestations for private.

omar (eng-platform): Add safety: per-tenant fallback opt-out and an emergency routing-freeze API. Also feature-flag rollout and dry-run.

trent (arch): We'll include a routing-lock flag and versioned manifest with backward compatibility checks.

yun (infra): I'll deliver sims and a pre-warm estimator. ETA: 10 business days.

claire (solutions): I'll collect 3 customer constraint docs in 1 week and map them to gates.

harry (sales): I'll line up pilots ASAP.

deploy-bot: scheduled: infra/experiment/policy-proto deploy by trent at 2024-11-01T09:00:00Z

lina (product): Action recap: trent+omar policy v0 (EOW); yun sims (10d); claire customer mapping (1w); harry pilots (ASAP). I'll post milestone roadmap to #product-docs later today. Flag blockers here. :rocket:
